output_excerpt: {"observations":["hawking/hawking_native.py (sha256 f21f1f5389c025382b36425667607962d11cb3e13285073445518e90f229b6b8, 76887 bytes) is the profile-driven native model connector and resident transport; its docstring states the module only translates model payloads into the selected native executable's request format and back, with a one-shot path that is also the fallback when the resident executable is unavailable.","The module declares two wire schemas, PROTOCOL_SCHEMA = 'hawking.native.resident.v1' and QWEN38_PROTOCOL_SCHEMA = 'hawking.qwen38.resident.v1', binding the connector to an explicit artifact/protocol identity rather than an implicit runtime.","Fail-closed runtime selection is implemented via context-local ContextVars: _NATIVE_RUNTIME_SPAWN_ALLOWED (default True) and _NATIVE_BOUNDARY_TRACE_ALLOWED (default True), with native_runtime_spawning_allowed() reading the spawn flag and suppress_native_runtime_spawning() setting both to False and resetting them in a finally block.","The comment above the ContextVars states a constrained HAWKING worker may observe an already-live native resident but must not turn a failed request into a new child process, and that the fence is context-local so an ordinary daemon request can still use its explicitly owned recovery path while a concurrent constrained request fails closed.","_boundary_trace() is opt-in cross-process telemetry gated by _NATIVE_BOUNDARY_TRACE_ALLOWED and the HAWKING_BOUNDARY_TRACE environment variable; it records component, event, pid, wall_ns, monotonic_ns plus safe fields, and swallows OSError so telemetry never changes the model-call result.","REQUIRED_FUSION_ENV pins four fusion flags: HAWKING_QWEN38_FUSE_ADD_RMSNORM=1, HAWKING_QWEN38_FUSE_GQA_QKV=1, HAWKING_QWEN38_FUSE_DN_INPROJ=1, HAWKING_QWEN38_FUSE_MLP=swiglu, making the fused-kernel configuration an explicit contract rather than an ambient default.","The error taxonomy is explicit and fail-closed: HawkingNativeError (base), HawkingNativeConfigError (incomplete/unsafe profile), HawkingNativeProtocolError (missing promised structured record), HawkingNativeTimeout (caller-owned timeout exceeded), and HawkingNativeUnavailable (caller intentionally forbids creating or reviving a runtime).","_absolute_path(value, field_name) rejects empty/whitespace values with HawkingNativeConfigError(f'{field_name} is required'), showing path fields are validated before use rather than defaulted.","The file imports subprocess, tempfile, threading, queue, uuid, and contextvars, consistent with a resident transport that owns process lifecycle and request/response plumbing; the observed 4000-byte window is 5.2% of the file, so downstream sections (resident spawn, request framing, timeout handling) remain unobserved and must not be inferred."],"sources":[{"path":"hawking/hawking_native.py","sha256":"f21f1f5389c025382b36425667607962d11cb3e13285073445518e90f229b6b8","sha256_scope":"full_file","bytes":76887,"observed_bytes":4000,"truncated":true}],"recommendations":[{"contract":"Bounded native/CPU contract for the admitted P11_NATIVE_CPU read evidence","owner":"hawking/hawking_native.py (native connector + resident transport);
